notes.title: Fast-forward Feature for Combat Animation and Some Bugfixes
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

It’s been a while since our last update!

We originally had no plans to update Just Deserts further, but we recently had the opportunity to make a few small improvements before moving on to our next games.

One of the biggest pain points (even for us!) has been the battle animations. Waiting for every attack move to play out can be frustrating, so we decided to add a [b]fast-forward button[/b] to speed up combat!

Our initial idea was to allow players to speed up animations by holding down a button. However, since Just Deserts was built using Ren'Py— which isn’t optimized for battle systems— we ran into some implementation challenges. In the end, we settled on adding a [b]toggleable animation speed button[/b] on the combat dashboard instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25755520/1766439c9d0baf204ae5e49aedbc19720620298d.png[/img]

If you've played Just Deserts before, now you can speedrun the game and complete all the endings in no time!

Additionally, we’ve fixed a bug that caused the game to crash if a player didn’t select a target while using a heroine’s support move.

That’s all for now! We hope these small changes improve your experience, even just a little bit. Stay tuned for more news in our next announcements.

Until then,
- Vifth Floor Dev Team

notes.title: Update Notes for May 5th: Eve's battle support bug fix
notes.notes:
Minor battle bugfix:
- Repro: use any of Eve's battle support (any support with one or two targets).
- Cause: ReactiveUI calls BattleAnimation with a list of targets instead of a single Alien object as a target.
- Fix: ReactiveUI function call is fixed.

notes.title: [Update] Save/Load Error Is Still There, Fix Is Underway
notes.notes:
Some hours ago we said that the save/load feature has been fixed, but actually it's not fixed yet.
It's a miscommunication between the team members, and we would like to make it clear to everyone that we thought the last update include the save/load error; actually not and the dev still working on it.

We will try to fix the save/load error issue within 24 hours.

[b]Update:[/b]
We've identified the problem and fixed the error in the development branch. Right now, we are testing the new save load mechanism to make sure that it won't cause any new problem. 

Several tests had been done to some user's save games which is reported to be broken. The results so far indicates that the fix is actually working and won't cause future problems.

We plan to include this fix in the next update which is planned to be rolled out tonight (Jakarta Time, GMT+7) if everything went well.

Wish us luck :)
